newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - T-bonds to seek short-term base at 114-12.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - T-bonds to seek short-term base at 114-12.

text.p: September T-bond futures will look to support around 114-12 to form a base on Tuesday from which the contract can move higher, technical analysts said.
"It looks like 114-12 the old channel top, could offer a bit of support," said Stavros Loizou, manager of strategic trading at Fuji Bank in London.
Added to that, he said the low 114s had been a congestion area so the region might mark a short-term base.
"But more conclusive evidence would be necessary and that would be provided by a trade above 115-02," he said.
At 0954 GMT September T-bond futures were at 114-19 in automated trade, down two ticks from Monday's Chicago settlement.
Christian Bado, senior technical analyst at Ferrier Lullin in Geneva, agreed 114-12 should hold the market for the next few days.
"That coincides with good channel support," he said.
From there Bado said September T-bonds might rebound back towards 115-00 where they could consolidate sideways for a while before continuing their down move.
Longer term, the market would slip towards 113-27, then 113-00, he said.
Loizou said if 114-12 failed to hold the market further support would be offered at 114-00.
"Then there is a major cycle low 113-27. That will be a key level," he said.
At the short end, December Eurodollars were at 94.095, unchanged on the day.
